llm.summary: The skill is largely purpose-aligned for managing mymind, but its setup instructions include running an unverified remote installer script.

dimensions.detail: Using an OOMOL connector and server-side credentials is coherent for this integration, but it gives the agent access to potentially private mymind content and mutation actions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to install the oo CLI via curl piped to bash and PowerShell irm piped to iex, without checksum, signature verification, or explicit user approval before executing remote code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime use is scoped to oo connector schema/run commands, but the first-time setup section includes curl/PowerShell installer commands that sit outside the declared Bash(oo *) tool scope.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact describes one-time CLI installation, login, and mymind account connection; it does not show background services, backdoors, or hidden persistence, but those setup steps create lasting local/account state.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly targets mymind operations through the OOMOL oo CLI and discloses read, write, and destructive actions, with explicit confirmation requirements for state-changing operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the setup path before installing. Prefer installing the oo CLI from an official, verifiable package or installation guide yourself, and only let the skill perform mymind write or destructive actions after checking the exact target and payload.
llm.findings: [SC2] expected: Installing the required oo CLI is purpose-aligned setup, but the artifact-backed pipe-to-shell and iex commands are a real supply-chain concern because they execute mutable remote installer code without verification.
